title: Poly resistor flavor sheet-Rs / TC (res_high_po, res_xhigh_po)
claim: Issue #4 -- characterizes sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po and sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po (the two PDK poly-resistor flavors named in the issue; there is no separate 'precision p+ poly' cell -- res_high_po IS the precision, non-silicided p+ poly flavor, confirmed against the PDK's continuous/models_resistors.spice, no third flavor exists) via the two-length (L=1um, L=20um; W=1um) slope method, which extracts sheet resistance excluding head/contact resistance: Rs = (R(L20)-R(L1))*W/(L20-L1). Process axis covers BOTH the standard tt/ss/ff/sf/fs MOS/BJT corners (confirmed to leave resistor value unchanged -- all five corners include the same continuous/parameters_res_nom.spice) and the PDK's dedicated resistor-value skew corners ll (low) / hh (high), which is where sky130_fd_pr poly-resistor sheet-Rs actually varies (continuous/parameters_res_low.spice / parameters_res_high.spice); see sim/pdk.json's process_corners notes. Informs the resistor-flavor recommendation (PTAT resistor / output ladder / trim network) that spec/topology-survey.md's provisional res_high_po pick should be checked against. Supply axis intentionally fixed at nominal 3.30V: both flavors are biased by an ideal 1uA DC current source with no supply-referenced terminal in the DUT -- see design/device-characterization-summary.md.
statistical_convention: N/A for the corner-matrix Rs/TC claim above. Device-mismatch sigma is reported separately in the summary record as a PDK-derived (not simulated) coefficient: sw_mm_sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po / __res_xhigh_po from continuous/models_global.spice, applied as sigma_R/R = coefficient / sqrt(W*L*mult).
